title: Minimum Window Subsequence
goal: Find the shortest substring of s1 containing s2 as a subsequence, preferring the leftmost tie.
strategy: Track the latest possible start for each matched prefix of s2 while scanning s1. Update target positions backward so one source character is not reused twice; each completed target supplies a candidate window.
